editorialPrinciples: The original local master is the only timeline clock and begins at zero.
Use conservative straight cuts, deterministic A/B alternation and alternate source in-points on reuse.
Return shots 007 and 008 during chapter 07; end chapter 06 on shot 012; begin chapter 08 on shot 015; let shot 016 own the final sustained image.
Never automatically reverse human or physically directional movement.
Reserve 10–15 percent punch-ins, alternate crops, approximately 85–115 percent speeds, brief darkness, colour finishing and titles for reviewed local editing.

handoff.title: The Signal Bearer
handoff.summary: A conservative full-length assembly with local master audio, deterministic recurrence and room for restrained Resolve punch-ins, retimes, brief darkness and final colour work.

gradeTarget.notes: Protect graphite and cold-blue separation; keep warning red rare; introduce muted amber and natural dawn only near the ending.

finishingOptions: 10–15 percent digital punch-ins on reviewed reused shots
reviewed speed changes between approximately 85 and 115 percent
titles and credits added only in DaVinci Resolve
